stock_locations_kind_room_consistency.name: stock_locations_kind_room_consistency
stock_locations_kind_room_consistency.value: ("stock_locations"."kind" = 'room' and "stock_locations"."room_id" is not null) or ("stock_locations"."kind" = 'storage' and "stock_locations"."room_id" is null)

stock_transactions_count_snapshot.name: stock_transactions_count_snapshot
stock_transactions_count_snapshot.value: ("stock_transactions"."operation" = 'count_correction' and "stock_transactions"."quantity_before" is not null and "stock_transactions"."quantity_after" is not null and "stock_transactions"."balance_version" is not null) or ("stock_transactions"."operation" <> 'count_correction' and "stock_transactions"."quantity_before" is null and "stock_transactions"."quantity_after" is null and "stock_transactions"."balance_version" is null)
